source_of_authority: RC2-V4-set/certification-metrics.md (preregistered thresholds and hard gates, sha256 8b8b88ee7e13b3306c009f4121bf9a347e1402f23b1601aa350fb23611701fbd)
RC2-V4-set/blind-manifest.json (preregistered counts: 62 compound CORE, 141 atoms, 40 critical/120 standard)
RC1-run/phase2/scoring-policy.json (established policy shape; superseded by this file for V4)

denominators.semantic_exact: all 160 CORE cases; no exclusion after key
denominators.proof_safe_exact: all 160 CORE cases; no exclusion after key
denominators.product_exact: all 160 CORE cases; no exclusion after key
denominators.compound_atom: all expected atom targets in preregistered compound CORE cases (62 cases, 141 atoms per preregistration); atoms without a valid target excluded only if key structural validation flags them before scoring
denominators.critical_product: all preregistered critical CORE cases (40; rule: final_flags intersect {safety, age_legal} nonempty)
denominators.auto_precision: all predicted auto decisions (product_action in {AUTO_SUPPORTED, AUTO_CONTRADICTED})

runtime_failure_policy.rule: frozen before key per spec 7; Phase 1 had zero failures so this is a general rule, not a patch
runtime_failure_policy.runtime_hard_gate: applied separately by certification thresholds (unhandled runtime exception > 0 = FAIL)

semantic_output_mapping.alias_rationale: explicit same-runtime-concept renames emitted by the frozen engine; recorded by the frozen Phase-1 driver

review_required_handling.rule: REVIEW_REQUIRED is NEVER translated to a semantic target class post hoc
review_required_handling.scoring: predicted semantic REVIEW_REQUIRED is a semantic abstention/non-exact prediction and counts as INCORRECT against all four semantic target classes (SUPPORTED, CONTRADICTED, PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE)

proof_safe_output_mapping.authoritative_field: prediction.proof_safe_verdict (recorded by the frozen Phase-1 driver: SUPPORTED iff final route auto, else INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE)
proof_safe_output_mapping.rc2_review_bucket_note: RC2 does not produce a distinct REVIEW_REQUIRED proof verdict; non-auto routes are recorded as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE by the frozen driver. Per spec 9 these are NOT converted post hoc in either direction; exact proof-safe scoring compares this recorded field against the key.
proof_safe_output_mapping.confidence_inference: forbidden; proof-safe target is never inferred from reviewer confidence in Phase 2

exact_only.AUTO_SUPPORTED: correct only against key product_expected_action AUTO_SUPPORTED
exact_only.AUTO_CONTRADICTED: correct only against key product_expected_action AUTO_CONTRADICTED
exact_only.REVIEW_REQUIRED: correct only against key product_expected_action REVIEW_REQUIRED
exact_only.ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT: correct only against key product_expected_action ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT

product_output_mapping.abstain_note: RC2-FUSION-V1 cannot produce ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT (Phase 1: 0). REVIEW_REQUIRED against expected ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT is a product-action MISMATCH; review and abstain are never merged after labels open.

primary_proof_based.definition: evaluation contract (frozen): auto is right iff the verdict matches proof_safe

secondary_product_based.definition: reported for diagnosis only; not threshold-bearing
secondary_product_based.correct_iff: key.product_expected_action equals the predicted AUTO_* class

invalid_accepted_proof.structural_validity: an accepted route (route == auto) whose recorded engine proof cannot be re-derived by the frozen deterministic validator (frozen engine re-run must reproduce the recorded verdict; frozen fidelity checks must pass)
invalid_accepted_proof.semantic_soundness: an accepted auto decision that exceeds the proof_safe target (AUTO_SUPPORTED with key.proof_safe != SUPPORTED, or AUTO_CONTRADICTED with key.proof_safe != CONTRADICTED) counts as an invalid accepted proof for the 0-tolerance proof-safety gate
invalid_accepted_proof.proof_valid_field_role: prediction.proof_valid is recorded metadata only; it does NOT by itself establish soundness

hallucinated_proof.definition: an accepted proof referencing a span id absent from the rebuilt packet, a premise absent from the packet, a quote that does not match the source, or an external fact absent from the authorized evidence
hallucinated_proof.mechanical_validation: frozen reviewer.validate_fidelity over the rebuilt packet (deterministic, no model calls) plus span-id membership checks

unsafe_auto_definitions.critical_unsafe_AUTO_SUPPORTED: predicted AUTO_SUPPORTED on a critical case where key.product_expected_action != AUTO_SUPPORTED (equivalently key.proof_safe != SUPPORTED)
unsafe_auto_definitions.critical_unsafe_AUTO_CONTRADICTED: predicted AUTO_CONTRADICTED on a critical case where key.product_expected_action != AUTO_CONTRADICTED (equivalently key.proof_safe != CONTRADICTED)
unsafe_auto_definitions.basis: expected product action + proof-safe target + preregistered criticality metadata; never post-hoc judgment

criticality_membership.source: sealed key.criticality (deterministic preregistered rule: final_flags intersect {safety, age_legal} nonempty; preregistered counts 40 critical / 120 standard)

subgroup_membership.source: sealed key.final_flags for the 11 flag subgroups; label-derived insufficiency subgroup = key.semantic_truth == INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (12 preregistered subgroups total per certification-metrics.md)

compound_membership.source: key.final_flags includes compound (preregistered: 62 CORE cases; blind-manifest atoms.compound_core = 62)

atom_prediction_extraction.source_field: prediction.proof_object.engine.atom_results (frozen engine output, present on all 160 Phase-1 rows; 202 atoms total)
atom_prediction_extraction.ordering: engine order = frozen decompose_claim order over the claim (deterministic)
atom_prediction_extraction.atom_identity: positional atom_id A1..An as emitted by the frozen engine
atom_prediction_extraction.semantic_verdict_field: atom_results[n].verdict, normalized with the same pure name aliases as top-level semantic mapping
atom_prediction_extraction.proof_verdict_field: none; the frozen engine produces no atom-level proof-safe verdict, so compound atom scoring is semantic-verdict exact only (documented limitation, frozen)
atom_prediction_extraction.malformed_or_missing: row flagged ATOM_EXTRACTION_INCOMPLETE; missing predicted atoms score as incorrect expectations; extra predicted atoms are recorded as decomposition errors and do not enter the numerator

atom_alignment.rule: deterministic positional alignment by atom_id order (frozen decompose_claim guarantees deterministic decomposition); fallback only if key atom ids are incompatible: normalized exact claim-atom text match

atom_count_mismatch.extra_unmatched_predicted_atom: aggregation/decomposition error, recorded and reported; not scored as correct
atom_count_mismatch.conservative_default: never score only the atoms that happen to match

atom_accuracy.numerator: expected atom targets with exact normalized semantic verdict match
atom_accuracy.denominator: all expected atom targets in preregistered compound CORE (141 per preregistration)

product_accuracy.definition: top-level product exact accuracy on the 62 compound CORE cases

aggregation_correctness.status: secondary diagnostic only; NOT a preregistered hard gate for V4
aggregation_correctness.definition: report whether RC2 top-level semantic output is consistent with its own atom outputs; reported after official-score freeze, never changes the verdict

review_metrics.FP: predicted REVIEW_REQUIRED and key expects an auto or abstain action
review_metrics.FN: predicted auto or abstain and key.product_expected_action == REVIEW_REQUIRED

abstain_metrics.FP: predicted ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT and key expects another action
abstain_metrics.FN: key expects ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT and prediction is not ABSTAIN_INSUFFICIENT
abstain_metrics.precision_recall: reported when denominators exist; RC2 never predicts abstain, so predicted-count 0 is reported mechanically

potential_label_error_policy.rule: sealed label remains official; official score remains; apparent label errors flagged POTENTIAL_BLIND_LABEL_ERROR only after official-score freeze; alternate-label sensitivity reported separately; certification verdict unchanged unless the preregistered protocol explicitly allows

error_severity_policy.detail_timing: per-case severity classification only after official-score freeze

wilson_ci.threshold_interaction: none; CI never affects hard thresholds

rounding.authoritative: raw integer counts and exact fractions

certification_verdict_logic.RC2_CERTIFIED: all preregistered hard gates and thresholds pass
certification_verdict_logic.RC2_NOT_CERTIFIED: any hard gate or threshold fails

score_order_mandatory: mechanical scoring with this frozen policy
